title: Repository maintenance backlog
purpose: File-based tracking for engineering and automation closure work. This is not the executable task queue; runnable work must still enter automation/task_queue.json through its registered scheduler and CAS lifecycle.

items.title: Complete independent Source Discovery → Assessment live end-to-end validation
acceptance: Run at least two distinct batches with no more than 20 URLs and 10 MB per batch
Verify immutable artifact digests and predecessor linkage
Verify durable cursor advancement and interruption/resume
Verify no automatic source activation or assessment-artifact publication
Verify exact discovery fingerprint backlog is zero or partitioned into a new verified generation
items.next_action: Use the registered Watchdog scheduler to dispatch and independently verify the exact Discovery → Assessment chain; do not bypass queue CAS or task/resource leases.

items.title: Reconcile three historical FAILED task records without rewriting history
acceptance: Use supported queue CAS/scheduler lifecycle only
Record verified supersession or cancellation disposition for each applicable task
Never relabel an actually failed production run as SUCCEEDED
Preserve event history and ensure no stale active lease remains
items.next_action: Add or use a schema-supported terminal resolution path for FAILED historical tasks, then reconcile using current successful-run evidence.

items.title: Complete file-based maintenance management and fresh Storage Management validation
acceptance: Keep engineering maintenance records in this file, not GitHub Issues
Keep executable work in the registered task queue
Run full Storage Management validation on the latest main revision
Record run ID, tested commit SHA and complete successful job evidence
items.next_action: Validate this backlog file in Storage Management and obtain a fresh successful validation run.

closure_rule: Do not mark an item complete without its stated evidence. Do not declare the overall automation closed until every item is complete and a fresh production audit, publish, remote verification and uu.conf SHA check all pass.
